source.name: Spicer Designs Gym template
source.rightsEvidence: The official downloadable template is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. The source license is retained in this dossier, and the official preview preserves the required Spicer Designs attribution in its footer.

provenance.capture: Full-page screenshots were made from Spicer Designs' official live gym preview at 1440x900 and 390x844 after scrolling through the complete page to load lazy media. The official preview renders the same design as the licensed downloadable HTML package. No source text, layout, or imagery was edited; no source image file was separately retained.
provenance.diagnostics: At both viewports document width matched the viewport exactly. The source gym hero image decoded successfully. The captured design is a dark, timetable-led gym template; all sample memberships, prices, class schedules, coach identities, equipment counts, reviews and policies are fictional demo content.
provenance.attribution: Spicer Designs, CC BY 4.0. Required attribution remains visible in the screenshot footer. Internal visual-mechanics reference only; do not ship source branding, text, code or imagery to client sites.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A near-black strength-gym site makes the decision facts visible rather than hiding them behind a lead form: opening-hours utility line, compact identity/navigation, an atmospheric equipment scene behind a large condensed promise, two direct actions, then a week-grid class timetable. It continues with three membership levels and cancellation terms, a specific equipment inventory, an un-intimidating first-visit induction explanation, trainer profiles, member objections, concise FAQs, and a simple join/contact form. Acid green marks only key states and actions. The source's AI-made hero artwork is placeholder-only.

heroGeometry.mode: full-width dark equipment scene with left-aligned stacked condensed headline
heroGeometry.alignment: headline, concise policy note and paired actions occupy a narrow left column while gym equipment and shadow fill the right
heroGeometry.viewport: one compact promise and both primary paths fit in the first desktop scene without requiring a scroll-trigger

navigationGeometry.mode: thin opening-hours utility rail followed by a compact wordmark and anchor nav
navigationGeometry.placement: top edge, with timetable and membership anchors prominent
navigationGeometry.mobile: small wordmark and menu control; no wide desktop nav compression or horizontal scroll

typography.scale: short uppercase eyebrow, compressed multi-line hero, clear medium-size section titles, compact timetable labels

palette.contrastIntent: reserve bright green for selected schedule state, membership emphasis and actionable controls; maintain readable body contrast

imageTreatment.crop: wide hero cover crop with a dark copy-safe gradient
imageTreatment.focalPoint: equipment silhouette and subtle green practical light remain visible to the right; source artwork is not reusable client imagery

servicePresentation.pattern: weekly schedule first, followed by explicit membership tiers and a factual equipment inventory
servicePresentation.interaction: day tabs may filter a verified timetable; classes, capacity, membership features and equipment must come from sealed client facts

ctaPlacement.primary: membership or trial/join path in the hero
ctaPlacement.early: show the timetable immediately after the opening scene, before longer facility narrative

motion.primitive: visitor-controlled day selection for a weekly schedule with small, reduced-motion-safe state changes
motion.reducedMotion: render the schedule and all membership details statically with visible selected states

rules: keep opening message and join/visit actions before the schedule
convert the week grid into readable day-selectable sessions rather than shrinking columns
stack membership tiers with terms adjacent to prices
present equipment groups in a vertical inventory
preserve large touch targets and zero horizontal overflow

prohibitedPatterns: source gym brand, copy, phone, schedule, coach names or sample membership data
invented prices, class capacity, opening hours, contract terms or equipment inventory
source hero art presented as client-owned photography
fake reviews, trainer biographies, results or health outcomes
dark card wall with no typographic or timetable hierarchy
fake live availability or booking behavior

requiredSignatureElements.description: a narrow hours/policy rail above the brand navigation using only verified client facts
dark equipment-led poster hero with a compact service promise and visible next steps
class schedule is an early, legible decision surface
membership choices show client-approved price and terms without hidden exclusions
specific, fact-grounded explanation of what a new visitor can expect

acceptanceChecks: membership prices, hours, schedules and facility details come only from verified client inputs
schedule remains readable and keyboard/touch operable on mobile
the gym decision facts appear before extended brand narrative
hero is legible at desktop 100 percent zoom
all source art and identity are excluded from client deliverables
mobile capture and rendered page have no horizontal overflow

review.scope: official source package license, official full-page desktop/mobile captures, reference prompt, and non-transferable demo facts
